title: Codex discussion reply
description: Exactly ONE reply in the owner's same-terminal Codex discussion channel (D-024 Amendment 8, M0-T110; rows R236/R238/R239). Flattened to the provider's strict structured-output subset like operator_ask_answer.schema.json: no combinators, additionalProperties false, every property required. Emit "" for unused strings. The supervisor-side codex_channel.validate_reply remains the authority for bounds, redaction, and the closed disposition vocabulary; this schema only shapes the provider output. The reply changes nothing by itself - dispositions are recorded durably and the owner decides.

reply.description: The concise discussion reply, grounded ONLY in the bounded turn packet and read-only repository inspection. Say 'unknown from the provided state' rather than inventing a fact.

disposition.description: REQUIRED closed vocabulary (D-024-R239). ADVICE_ONLY: information, no action. QUEUE_NEXT_BOUNDARY: nonurgent item for the next safe boundary. REVISE_CURRENT_TASK: an existing authorized repair finding for the current task (enters ONLY through the existing review route). PROPOSE_NEW_TASK: new scope needing explicit owner promotion and durable capture. URGENT_PAUSE / STOP_FOR_OWNER: genuine safety/integrity urgency only - the channel records attention durably; it never actuates.

updated_summary.description: The refreshed bounded durable thread summary carrying the discussion context forward (what was discussed, decided, open). "" keeps the prior summary.

confidence_note.description: One short sentence on how grounded the reply is (what was read vs assumed). "" if nothing to add.

evidence_refs.description: STABLE references the reply rests on: commit SHAs, content digests, repo-relative paths, symbols, test names - never bare line numbers (D-024-R238). [] when none.
